name: cortico-world-pythonenv
description: Cortico World: sandboxed Python work directory with pip, restricted shell, audit, and high-risk deny rules (Windows/MXC, Linux/bubblewrap).

zh.description: 在用户自选工作目录内提供受限的文件、Python、pip 与 shell；Windows 经 MXC、Linux 经 bubblewrap 隔离，高危操作默认拒绝。

en.description: Sandboxed file, Python, pip and shell tools inside a user-chosen work directory; Windows via MXC, Linux via bubblewrap; high-risk actions denied by default.
